en: This is a vintage colorized postcard showing an industrial scene nestled among trees and a body of water, with a prominent red building, factory smokestacks, and what appears to be piles of timber or wood chips in the background. The foreground is a grassy hill with scattered trees. The text on the image side reads 'Parti av Matfors', which means 'View of Matfors' in Swedish. The back side of the postcard includes space for an address and is printed with the following: Konstförlaget FRAM, Stockholm, Foto. Axel Ohrlander, och Förlag Matfors Koop. Handl. Fören.
